text: I'm not sure, but the color of the soil and the\nrocks here is kinda different from that in the\nplaces we've passed so far...
It's better to be careful and not touch them...
I'm not sure, but...The soil and the rocks here\nseem to contain tremendously potent poison...
A-are you telling us that we're being surrounded\nby poison now??
Seems like it's fine as long as it doesn't touch\nour skin. Let's just move forward without touching\nanything.
Wow...! The god killer trap! It's real...!\nHmm? Oh, I'm sorry. It was written on an old book.
It's the trap that was created to kill a god\ncalled Obligaus in Mt. Mithurna.
It was written on the book that because of\nthis thing, people called this place the\n"Devil's Cave"...
A trap to kill god...\nWho made it and why? How did it work?\nJust staring at it left you completely clueless...
Scary monsters were said to come out of this trap\nregularly to attack Obligaus...
I don't know who made it cuz it wasn't written on\nthe book...Anyway, looks like it's already broken,\nso don't worry, no monsters will come out...
